general.title: General
general.body: The name and handle for your workspace. The name shows across the app; the slug is its URL-safe handle.

integrations.heading: GitHub
integrations.intro: Connect a fine-grained personal access token to import files from private repositories. The link pre-selects the minimum Kedge needs (Contents: read-only) — just choose “Only select repositories” and pick the repos to review. The token is encrypted and never shown again — remove it any time.
integrations.ownerHint: A fine-grained token sees one owner's repos: yours by default, or one organization — enter it above so the link opens pre-scoped (changing the owner inside GitHub's form resets the pre-filled permissions). Orgs can block these tokens or require approval. For a private repo owned by another user where you're a collaborator, fine-grained tokens can't help — use a classic token (broader repo scope) instead.
integrations.connectedNotice: GitHub connected. Private repositories now import through this token.
